thread:
Marta: kicking off canary for quantized-gpt-eu v2 -> v3, 10% traffic, route=eu-west-1
Devon: thanks — terraform apply finished in ci, helm chart pushed. deploy-bot: starting rollout :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary 10% created for release=quantized-gpt-eu v3 (strategy: staged)
Calvin: seeing spike in Pending pods on gpu-pool-eu-2, autoscaler didn't add nodes yet
sre-jen: rolling `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep quantized-gpt` — several `CrashLoopBackOff` and `ContainerCreating`
Marta: logs from a stuck pod: ```Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  22s  default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 6 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
``` 
Devon: weird — nodepool quota should be 8 GPUs free, but `terraform show` in remote state shows desired_count=4 (drift?).
Calvin: I think the autoscaler annotation got wiped during a config sync: `cluster.autoscaler/scale-enabled: "false"` in the nodepool helm values
Marta: omg, GitOps reconciler must've applied older helm values — we merged a fix but the repo was out of sync with the workspace
ops-bot: ALERT: Terraform workspace drift detected for module.gke.nodepool.gpu_pool_eu - desired=8 actual=4
sre-jen: canary traffic is still at 10% but error rate jumped to 18% — automatic rollback should trigger at 10% errors
Devon: deploy-bot audit logs show the autorevert hook ran but returned 200 OK without performing rollback (message: "no matching release found")
Calvin: confirmed: helm lookup `helm status quantized-gpt-eu-v3` returns "release: not found" — our canary pipeline used a generated release name that didn't match the gitops-managed release name
Marta: so the autorevert tried `helm rollback quantized-gpt-eu-v3 1` against a non-existent release. Ugh.
Devon: quick mitigation — scale traffic back to 0% on the router: `curl -X POST https://router/api/traffic -d '{"release":"quantized-gpt","percent":0,"region":"eu"}'`
sre-jen: done, traffic to v3 -> 0%; started draining failing pods and reinstating v2 replicas
Calvin: created a hotfix PR to add a guard in the autorevert step: validate release exists before rollback and fallback to route-level cutover
Marta: we should also patch our gitops sync to reject helm values that disable autoscaler or at least require an explicit override — file a follow-up infra ticket?
Devon: filed INF-1422: "gitops: prevent nodepool autoscaler disabled via helm values" with backlog priority P1
ops-bot: Incident closed by Marta — root cause: gitops/helm values drift + autorevert assumed release naming parity
Marta: takeaways: 1) add release-name reconciliation step in rollback, 2) block autoscaler-disable in nodepool charts, 3) add a smoke test that requests 2+ GPUs before approving canary
sre-jen: will add the smoke test to the canary CI job
Calvin: thanks everyone — postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow? :coffee:
Marta: yes, 10:30am. I'll drop the notes. :thumbsup:
